title: STEMMA canonical entity
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of one canonical knowledge entity (v1.0). IDs live in the stemma: namespace (ADR-0027).

id.description: Stable identifier, namespace stemma:<domain>.<slug>. Never reused.

type.description: Entity type. Expanded in schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061) for multidisciplinary bachelor-level coverage: adds principle, theorem, operator, function, distribution, process, structure, system, material, reaction, organelle, technique, instrument, algorithm, data-structure, protocol, standard, dataset, mission, constant. Additive; type changes on existing entities remain forbidden.

level.description: Knowledge complexity, not a curriculum/grade tag: foundational (school/early undergraduate), intermediate (core undergraduate), advanced (late undergraduate/first-year graduate). Schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061).

definition.description: Scientific definition exactly as meter example with reference — claim with warrant definitional + evidence per L1, not mere orientation, must show agreed status and source reference per ADR-0044

learning_objectives.description: Observable outcomes a bachelor-level learner should achieve for this entity. Optional; does not encode a grade or syllabus (schema 1.4.0, ADR-0061).

applications.description: Representative real-world or cross-domain applications. Optional; schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061).

limitations.description: Scope conditions, approximations, or known limits of validity. Optional but strongly recommended for laws/models. Schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061).

equation.description: Canonical mathematical form using defined symbols (optional)

statement.description: Precise verbal or logical statement of the law/theorem/principle/algorithm.

equation.description: Primary symbolic form (LaTeX or plain notation).

dimensions.description: MLT-style dimension for quantities/units, e.g. 'M L T^-2'.

formal.description: Machine-readable formal content for laws, theorems, equations, quantities, algorithms and protocols. Schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061).

symbol.description: Symbol(s) for the quantity or law (optional)

key_experiments.description: Classic experiments or demonstrations that establish this concept.

subdomain.description: Subdomain within domain, e.g. mechanics, per vocabularies/subdomains.yaml (ADR-0034). Optional but required for physics-core v2.

source_refs.description: Canonical source records that support this entity definition — dual verification with embedded provenance (ADR-0043). At least 1 required for physics-core.

governed_by.description: Governing laws that govern this entity — deterministic placement without LLM reasoning. Every physics entity must have at least one (see PHYSICS-GOVERNING-LAWS.md and physics-governing-registry.yaml). At least 1 required for physics-core v2.

review_mode.description: Who exercised canonical authority. 'human' is the ADR-0057 human promotion chain. 'owner_delegated' is the owner-sanctioned machine-verification path in ADR-0060: the SOLE_OWNER delegates canonicalization to deterministic gates and registered process agents, with no fabricated human reviewer. Defaults to 'human' when absent.

method.description: How the definition was checked (e.g. source-crosscheck, dimensional-analysis, executable-test).

verifier.description: Registered process/llm agent that executed the verification.

verification.description: Machine-readable verification record for owner-delegated canonicalization (ADR-0060).

delegated_by.description: Registered human SOLE_OWNER who delegated canonical authority.

delegation_ref.description: ADR or recorded owner decision authorizing this delegation.

scope.description: What this delegation covers (domain, source family, or tranche).

retire_when.description: Condition under which delegated canonicalization stops applying.

delegation.description: Owner delegation block required when review_mode=owner_delegated. Records authority, scope, and limits; it does not claim a human reviewed the artifact.

writer.description: Agent id who wrote this entity file, e.g. human:curator.001 — for audit trail and double verification (ADR-0043).

drafted_by.description: Machine agent (llm:* or process:*) that produced the original draft, when a human is the writer. Origin is preserved, never rewritten (CURATION-PROTOCOL §6, H1). Must resolve in schema/agent-registry.yaml.

original_author.description: Who originally stated the science (distinct from writer) — e.g., Halliday et al (ADR-0043).

link.description: URL or DOI to source for triple-check verification (ADR-0043).

retrieved_at.description: ISO date when source link was accessed (ADR-0043).

promotion_history.description: Append-only staged promotion records (ADR-0057): validator -> independent_validator -> board -> canonical.

actor.description: registered human agent id who acted at this stage

independence_waiver.description: Present only when the chain's actors are not all distinct. Makes the single-actor case legal and visible (ADR-0057 s1a). The interim waiver must state when it stops applying.

sanctioned_by.description: the SOLE_OWNER who sanctioned the waiver

board_waived.description: True when this terminal stage concluded the chain under an active board waiver (ENF-STEMMA-HITL-003 board_waiver) — the board stage was retired, not performed.

board_waived_reason.description: Why the board stage was retired for this record (audit trail for the waived chain).

extensions.description: Adaptive metadata seam (ADR-0017). Open at schema level so new knowledge-layer dimensions never hard-fail; the validator enforces that every key is registered in schema/extension-registry.yaml for this object kind.

version.description: ADR-0016 (implemented by ADR-0021): optional monotonically increasing object revision. Identity never encodes version (ADR-0003); content integrity is the derived content_hash.

updated_at.description: ADR-0016: optional ISO8601 last-modification timestamp of this entity object.

datasets.description: Empirical or reference datasets attached to the entity (measurements, constants, material properties, benchmark corpora). Schema 1.4.0 (ADR-0061).

propertyNames.description: Namespaced external identifier scheme, e.g. wd (Wikidata QID), orcid, doi, isbn, qudt, ucum, cas.

external_ids.description: ADR-0016 (implemented by ADR-0021): namespaced external anchor identifiers, e.g. external_ids: {wd: Q11402, qudt: unit-MeterPerSecondSquared}. Multi-valued per scheme. STEMMA stays independently authoritative — external IDs link and anchor, never import content.

rights.description: ADR-0016: optional per-object rights statement. Defaults to the repository-level CC BY 4.0 content license when absent.

stated_by.description: Person/group who first stated or discovered the claim (required when field present)

year.description: Year (CE; negative for BCE) of first statement/publication

where.description: Optional: the work/source where it was stated

note.description: Optional attribution caveat / uncertainty / contested-origin note

historical.description: Historical scientific attribution (ADR-0018): who first stated this claim and when. Distinct from provenance (record source).

adopted_from.description: ADR-0056 / REQ-STEMMA-EXP-002: provenance of an entity that ADOPTS or RE-IDENTIFIES a term originating elsewhere (another STEMMA entity or an external ontology). Records the external identifier + the relation by which adoption occurred, satisfying OBO Foundry Principle 8 (rdfs:isDefinedBy when a term is adopted under a new identifier). Distinct from external_ids (which anchors identity, it does not record adoption) and from provenance (which records the source of the CONTENT, not the identity). Absent for entities that are not adoptions.

external_id.description: The external identifier the term is adopted from, as scheme:value (e.g. 'wd:Q11402', 'obo:UO_0000008') or a bare stemma: entity id when adopting within STEMMA.

relation.description: How the adopted term relates to its origin: exact/close/broad/narrow match (SKOS-style), reidentification (same entity, new identifier), or merge (two prior entities unified).

source_external_ids.description: Optional: additional external anchors of the ADOPTED-FROM origin (e.g. its DOI or ORCID), for provenance depth.

note.description: Optional human-readable adoption rationale or caveat (e.g. known divergence from the origin term).

adopted_at.description: Optional ISO date when the adoption was recorded.

authority.description: Per ADR-0049: whether this adoption was ratified internally or under delegated authority.

quantity_kind.description: SI classification of a quantity entity: base (of the seven SI base quantities) or derived (combination of base quantities). REQUIRED when type=quantity (owner directive 2026-09-22).

tensor_character.description: Tensorial character of a quantity entity: scalar/vector/tensor. REQUIRED when type=quantity (owner directive 2026-09-22).

same_dimensional_quantities.description: Quantity names sharing this entity's SI dimension class (for unit entities: quantities expressible in this unit). REQUIRED non-empty when type=quantity|unit; explicit null for types where the notion does not apply (law etc.). Owner directive 2026-09-22.

revalidation_debt.description: Revalidation debt (ADR-0057): obligations an entity owes because it was promoted before the corpus satisfied them. An entity with status 'outstanding' may not hold a review status.

status.description: outstanding = blocks review status; cleared = satisfied, attributable; deferred = owner-sanctioned postponement

incurred_at.description: ISO date the debt was incurred

items.description: Specific obligations owed (connection ids, entities to reconcile)

cleared_by.description: registered human who cleared it (validator / independent validator / board member)

deferred_until.description: condition or date the deferral ends
